source.how: each expected value is proved to be the value of the feature's definition at the doubles nearest the stored values, or within half a unit in its last place of it, by the theorem its record names in spec/XtractSpec/Records/SpectralMoments.lean; written by tests/reference/generate/lean_spectral_moments.py and checked by Lean's kernel
